name: Rune Pickaxe
description: Forged with raw aether crystals. Increases Aether Shard gathering yield by +1 and grants +20 Combat Attack.
descriptionTl: Pinanday mula sa hilaw na aether crystal. +1 ani ng Kristal at +20 Lakas sa Labanan.

name: Grove Woodcleaver
description: Reinforced timber blade. Increases Grove Wood gathering speed by +20% and grants +25 Combat Attack.
descriptionTl: Pinatibay na talim na pangkahoy. +20% bilis ng pagkuha ng Kahoy at +25 Lakas sa Labanan.

name: Granite Sledge
description: Crushes runic quarry stone with ease. +35 Combat Attack and +1 Cargo capacity on stone.
descriptionTl: Madaling dinudurog ang bato ng quarry. +35 Lakas sa Labanan at +1 kargada ng bato.

name: Void Aether Blade
description: Gleaming blade woven from condensed void essence. Strikes invading crusade soldiers for +65 Combat Attack.
descriptionTl: Kumikinang na talim mula sa siksik na void essence. +65 Lakas sa Labanan laban sa mga krusada.

name: Ironstone Plating
description: Heavy basalt chestplate. Grants +140 Max HP and reduces damage taken from invaders.
descriptionTl: Mabigat na baluting basalt. +140 Max HP at binabawasan ang pinsala mula sa kalaban.

name: Verdant Travel Cloak
description: Silken woven nomad cloak. Reduces fatigue stamina drain by 40% and increases speed by +20.
descriptionTl: Hinabing balabal ng manlalakbay. -40% pagod sa stamina at +20 bilis.

name: Aegis Guardian Core
description: Miniature kinetic field generator. Grants +220 Max HP and +30 Combat Attack.
descriptionTl: Maliit na generator ng kinetic na kalasag. +220 Max HP at +30 Lakas sa Labanan.

name: Zephyr Wind Boots
description: Lightweight enchanted boots. Grants +35 movement speed across the citadel.
descriptionTl: Magaan at may engkantong bota. +35 bilis ng paglakad sa kuta.

name: Aether Cargo Pouch
description: Folded pocket dimension allowing the bearer to haul +2 extra resource cargo per trip.
descriptionTl: Bulsang may sariling dimensyon: +2 dagdag na kargada bawat biyahe.

name: Eternal Vitality Charm
description: Spiritual amulet granting +80 Max HP and 25% stamina drain reduction.
descriptionTl: Espiritwal na agimat: +80 Max HP at -25% pagod sa stamina.

name: Obsidian Warblade
description: A blade knapped from Brimstone obsidian. Grants +45 Combat Attack and faster work swings.
descriptionTl: Talim na tinabas mula sa obsidian ng Brimstone. +45 Lakas sa Labanan at mas mabilis na pagtatrabaho.

name: Soulbound Shroud
description: Woven from harvested souls. Grants +120 HP and shrugs off fatigue.
descriptionTl: Hinabi mula sa inaning kaluluwa. +120 HP at hindi agad napapagod.

name: Tidal Amulet
description: An abyssal pearl set in coral. Grants +40 HP, +25% stamina efficiency and +1 cargo.
descriptionTl: Perlas ng bangin na nakalagay sa koral. +40 HP, +25% tipid sa stamina at +1 kargada.

name: Scrapforged Plating
description: Mecha scrap hammered into armor plates. Grants +90 HP and +10 Combat Attack.
descriptionTl: Scrap ng Mecha na pinukpok bilang baluti. +90 HP at +10 Lakas sa Labanan.
